tools.name: audit_tools
tools.description: Check the tool definitions an agent loads, before they cost tokens or fail: estimated tokens per tool, schema errors per provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, MCP; add openai_strict for strict mode) with JSON paths and fixed definitions, tool pairs models will confuse with fix hints, basic p

tools.name: diff_tools
tools.description: What changed in a tool list since you approved it? Compares "tools" or "url" now with "pin" (set_id from audit_tools/diff_tools) or "baseline" (earlier definitions). Each change is labeled breaking (removed tool or param, new required param, type or enum removal), suspicious (new text with injection

tools.name: check_mcp_server
tools.description: Does this remote MCP server work, and is it worth connecting or paying for? Sends initialize and tools/list only (never calls a tool) and reports reachability, protocol version, sign-in method (OAuth protected-resource metadata), x402 payment terms if it asks for payment, latency, tool count and tok

tools.name: watch_mcp_server
tools.description: Hosted watch (paid only; this MCP call validates and returns how to pay): ToolFit re-audits a public remote MCP server every 24 h ($0.25) or 6 h ($0.60) for 30 days and POSTs an HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON webhook to your https endpoint when its tools/list fingerprint or grade changes, or it goes unreac

tools.name: watch_status
tools.description: Free: state (active, expired, cancelled), interval, expiry, next check, last result (pin, grade, score, tool count) and webhook delivery counters for a watch. Needs watch_id and the secret returned when it was created.

tools.name: watch_cancel
tools.description: Free: cancel a watch (no further checks or webhooks; not refunded). Needs watch_id and the secret returned when it was created.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_tools, diff_tools, check_mcp_server, watch_mcp_server · Private data: audit_tools, check_mcp_server, watch_mcp_server, watch_status, watch_cancel · Public sink: watch_mcp_server, watch_status · Destructive: audit_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_tools, diff_tools, check_mcp_server, watch_mcp_server · Private data: audit_tools, check_mcp_server, watch_mcp_server, watch_status, watch_cancel · Public sink: watch_mcp_server, watch_status · Destructive: audit_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
